svg.text: California signup — readiness repair, redline and ordered human gates

g.text: S = sync call; A = durable event/job; D = persistence; H = human decision. Dashed responses are labeled returns.
API and Atlas are compressed into one participant for readability; persistence is a deterministic server action.
Design only. At most two repairs; founder then lawyer; exact review bundle; no automatic public policy publication.
